facts.summary: Anker 735 Charger (Nano II 65W) is a GaN II PPS 3-port 65W foldable wall charger with two USB-C ports and one USB-A port.
facts.positioning: A compact 65W wall charger for buyers who want one charger for supported phones, tablets, and USB-C notebooks.

key_specs.dual_port_output: USB-C1 + USB-C2: 45W + 20W; USB-C1 + USB-A: 40W + 22.5W; USB-C2 + USB-A: 12W + 12W

limitations: Samsung S22 Ultra supports Super Fast Charging with this charger, but not 45W Super Fast Charging 2.0.

use_cases: Charging a supported USB-C notebook from a compact wall charger
Charging up to three supported devices from one wall charger
Replacing separate phone, tablet, and USB-C notebook chargers when 65W total output is sufficient
not_for: Devices that require more than 65W sustained input
Buyers who need Samsung 45W Super Fast Charging 2.0 support

claims.claim: Anker 735 Charger (Nano II 65W) is model A2667.
The charger has two USB-C ports and one USB-A port.
The charger provides 65W total output with single USB-C port output up to 65W.
The charger is listed by Anker as a GaN II PPS charger with PowerIQ 3.0 and PowerIQ 2.0.
Lightning devices require a USB-C to Lightning cable and USB-C devices require a USB-C to USB-C cable; cables are sold separately.
Anker states the charger supports Samsung S22 Ultra Super Fast Charging but not 45W Super Fast Charging 2.0.
